baseline.note: ADR-0069 regression capture, extended by ADR-0074 with a fourth node. Two fixture-free bypass denials fail because the ancestor returns ALLOW; the positive control and the consumed-slot exclusion node fail because the ancestor requires caller-supplied args.slot_id instead of deriving and consuming the matching slot. Fixture setup completes before every property assertion. SCOPE OF THE F-1 CLAIM (ADR-0074 decision 2, verbatim): "F-1 makes a consumed slot a derivation candidate; the observable consequence is a false ambiguity denial on the index-sanctioned reuse path, asserted on persisted worker_slots columns. F-1 cannot produce a duplicate dispatch: the one-use compare-and-set independently forecloses it." The kill is on the LIVENESS face, not the safety face; a reviewer who expects "the mutant lets a bad dispatch through" is right to reject that framing, because no such scenario exists. Additionally: at ancestor 6b52252 the new node fails at its FIRST assertion for the same reason the existing positive control does (args.slot_id required), so it contributes a MUTATION KILL AT HEAD, NOT INDEPENDENT ANCESTOR REGRESSION EVIDENCE.

mutations.target_path: the three `dispatched_at IS NULL` sites in worker_semaphore (derivation SELECT, oncall one-use CAS, generation-guarded one-use CAS)
mutations.mutation: delete `dispatched_at IS NULL` from all three sites, so a consumed slot becomes a derivation candidate again
mutations.rationale: Issue #608. A consumed slot must never be re-derived. Under this mutant the index-sanctioned identity-reuse path becomes a two-row `ambiguous dispatch identity` denial, which the fourth node detects on persisted worker_slots columns with no dependence on any reason string (issue #607).
mutations.observed: FAILED (failures=2): the pre-existing positive control (via its reason-string assertion) and the new consumed-slot exclusion node (via `second['result']` and its persisted-state assertions). The two fixture-free bypass nodes are unaffected, as expected.
mutations.not_validated_by_dod_validate: RT-16 is a `regression`-kind record, and tests/dod_validate.py's validate_rt_baseline only invokes _validate_mutation when derived_kind == 'preservation'. This mutations array is therefore audit evidence for #608 and is NOT mechanically checked by the validator; it does not gate D06's flip. Claim no validator coverage for it.

baseline.note: ADR-0069 preservation capture, extended by ADR-0074 with a third node. 14 independently produced normal acquires across two crews converge on explicit hermetic capacity 7/2; the Program-authority gate refuses missing and wrong tokens for oncall reserve acquires; and an oncall acquire presenting a token from a FENCED-OUT generation is refused. The third node is what earns the 'live, current-generation' clause of RT-17's amended id text -- product made binding it a condition of D06 going green (DEFINITION-OF-DONE.md D06 changelog, 2026-09-02, PR #611). No third mutant is authored: M2 already kills it.

mutations.mutation: remove reserve_for_oncall from the normal-slot ceiling
mutations.rationale: A normal acquire must never consume the on-call reserve.
mutations.observed: FAILED (failures=1): the ceiling node only (7 != 5). The token node and the fenced-out-generation node both pass, as expected -- M1 does not touch the authority gate.

mutations.mutation: bypass the oncall authority-token rejection branch
mutations.rationale: An oncall reserve acquire without a live, current-generation Program authority token must be denied with exit 3. The same _authority_token_matches predicate carries both the missing/wrong-token refusal and the fenced-out-generation refusal, which is why one mutant kills both nodes and no third mutant is needed.
mutations.observed: FAILED (failures=2): the missing/wrong-token node AND the fenced-out-generation node. The ceiling node passes, as expected.

preflight_checks.id: omnigent sys_session_send patch MISSING — counted-seat dispatch will fail with 'Additional properties are not allowed'. Fix: python3 deploy/patches/omnigent_session_send_args.py --apply, then restart BOTH the server and the omnigent host daemon
preflight_checks.remediation: omnigent's SysSessionSendTool declares args with additionalProperties:false, so worker_semaphore's required slot_id/task_id/generation are rejected before any policy hook sees them and no counted engineer/QA/reviewer dispatch can succeed (#236). A hand edit to site-packages is erased by uv tool upgrade with no warning, and the symptom is indistinguishable from the original bug. Run deploy/patches/omnigent_session_send_args.py --apply, then restart the server AND the omnigent host daemon, which cache imports independently.
preflight_checks.fixture_exempt_reason: Exercising this check requires a real omnigent installation on the box: the check locates site-packages and inspects the installed spawn.py. A fixture would have to stand up a fake install tree, which would assert the fixture's own layout rather than the condition. The patch script itself is self-verifying instead -- --apply refuses on a moved anchor, refuses when the file is unchanged after writing, and self-reverts on a syntax error.
